newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya's main 91-day T-bills seen marginally lower.
newsitem.headline: Kenya's main 91-day T-bills seen marginally lower.

text.p: Kenya's main 91-day category of treasury bills were seen marginally lower at the weekly auction on Friday, Central Bank of Kenya officials said.

The bank said it offered an average yield of 21.625 percent, down 0.008 percent from last week, on the 91-day bill while on the 28-day category it offered an average yield of 16.500 percent from 16.384 last week.
Out of a total of 7.004 billion shillings tendered, the bank said it accepted some 4.085 billion shillings.
In the 28-day category, the bank accepted some 129.50 million shillings worth of bids while on the 91-day category the bank accepted 3.950 billion shillings worth of bids.
In the 182-day category the bank accepted a total of 6.05 million shillings, out of which 2.05 million shillings were non-competitive bids.
The central bank holds the auction every Thursday.
It invited tenders for treasury bills of six billion shillings for next Thursday's auction. The minimum amount allowed for investment is one million shillings.
